name: grape-nuts cereal
ingredientsText: whole grain wheat flour, malted barley flour, salt, dried yeast, vitamins and minerals: reduced iron, niacinamide, zinc oxide (source of zinc), vitamin b6, thiamin mononitrate (vitamin b1), folic acid.
notes: 'Nuts' is only in the name; there are no nuts. Malted barley is not one of the 9.
